# semaphore_ex_project_workflow_start (Action)

Starts one workflow run explicitly. The action returns after the server creates the run; it does not wait for workflow completion. Planning, refresh, and schema discovery never start work.

Known limitation: HashiCorp Terraform Plugin Framework v1.19.0 rejects non-null write-only Action inputs during plan validation (also reproduced with Terraform 1.16.3). This Action fails before invocation when such inputs are set; required write-only inputs make the Action unavailable. Ordinary resource write-only attributes and ephemeral preview resources are unaffected. The provider retains write-only protection and uses the unmodified official framework.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_project_workflow_start" "release" {
  config {
    project_id  = 1
    workflow_id = 4
    parameters  = { release = "2026.09.16", canary_percent = 10, verify = true }
    node_overrides = {
      "12" = { inventory_id = 3, git_branch = "main" }
    }
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_project_workflow_start.release
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) Project owning the target.
- `workflow_id` (Number) Workflow to run.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `node_overrides` (Attributes Map) Optional overrides keyed by workflow node ID. Each object follows the server's bounded workflow-node override contract. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_overrides))
- `parameters` (Dynamic) Optional native HCL object of declared workflow parameter values. Numbers and booleans retain their JSON types.
- `preflight_fingerprint` (String) Exact fingerprint from a separately performed workflow preflight. The provider never obtains one automatically.
- `preflight_token` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only review token paired with preflight_fingerprint. Supply it from an ephemeral input; the provider never reads or returns it.

<a id="nestedatt--node_overrides"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_overrides`

Optional:

- `arguments` (String) JSON-encoded task argument array or object.
- `environment_ids` (List of Number)
- `git_branch` (String)
- `inventory_id` (Number)
